health_cover_upgrade.name: Health Cover Upgrade
health_cover_upgrade.description: Increases medical coverage limit from $50,000 to $100,000
health_cover_upgrade.suitable_for: Travellers with pre-existing conditions or older travellers

smoker_cover.name: Smoker Cover
smoker_cover.description: Extends coverage for smoking-related medical claims typically excluded
smoker_cover.suitable_for: Smokers or those who quit within the last 12 months

adventure_sports.name: Adventure Sports Cover
adventure_sports.description: Covers injuries from adventure activities like skiing, scuba diving, and trekking
adventure_sports.suitable_for: Travellers planning adventure or extreme sports activities

trip_cancellation_plus.name: Trip Cancellation Plus
trip_cancellation_plus.description: Enhanced trip cancellation including cancel-for-any-reason up to 75% refund

baggage_protection_plus.name: Baggage Protection Plus
baggage_protection_plus.description: Enhanced baggage and personal belongings protection
baggage_protection_plus.suitable_for: Travellers carrying expensive electronics or valuables

maternity_cover.name: Maternity Cover
maternity_cover.description: Covers pregnancy complications and emergency delivery abroad
maternity_cover.suitable_for: Pregnant travellers up to 28 weeks gestation

covid_cover.name: COVID-19 Cover
covid_cover.description: Dedicated coverage for COVID-19 related cancellations and treatment abroad
highlights: Quarantine hotel costs up to 14 days
covid_cover.suitable_for: All travellers, especially to high-risk regions

rental_car_excess.name: Rental Car Excess Waiver
rental_car_excess.description: Covers the excess/deductible charged on rental car damage
rental_car_excess.suitable_for: Travellers planning to hire a car at destination

flight_delay_protection.name: Flight Delay Protection
flight_delay_protection.description: Cash compensation for flight delays and missed connections
highlights: Covers missed connections and rebooking fees
flight_delay_protection.suitable_for: Frequent flyers or travellers on tight itineraries

hotel_cancellation.name: Hotel & Accommodation Cover
hotel_cancellation.description: Covers non-refundable hotel and accommodation costs if trip is disrupted
hotel_cancellation.suitable_for: Travellers with fully pre-paid non-refundable accommodation

passport_loss.name: Passport & Document Loss
passport_loss.description: Covers emergency expenses from losing your passport or travel documents abroad

personal_liability.name: Personal Liability Cover
personal_liability.description: Covers legal liability if you accidentally injure someone or damage property abroad
personal_liability.suitable_for: Travellers visiting countries with high litigation risk (e.g. USA, UAE)
